meta.what: One representative simulated run per persona and scenario, as steps on a time axis.

step.minute: minute of that day the step starts
step.with: the persona played with, if any

fixes.tide: P6 The Tide: a daily job, a weekly card, a six-week season (era.tide, build queued 2026-11-20)
fixes.one_currency: P10 One currency: a clean voyage pays about three arcade wins in crystals
fixes.sinks: P7 More to spend crystals on: Ark refits, pilots, colour sets
fixes.chapters: P13 Voyage chapters: dock at any location reached and resume next sitting
fixes.puzzle_door: P14 A puzzle-first door: the Ratel's board is offered on Home and in the first-login guide
fixes.crew_seat: P15 Every crew vessel seats an arena card and a voyage squad, so two people share one seat
fixes.quest_rung: arc.unlock hole: a quest clears at I2, matching ECONOMY_TABLES' ~3 games to the Hangar
fixes.make_pays: P16 Making pays: a finished painting pays a little and can be shared, so the Toybox feeds the long game
fixes.breath: P5 The breath: after each result one offered next step, so a sitting crosses places

mira.name: Mira
mira.is: A mother who plays the Ratel's hex puzzle as a casual puzzle game on her phone, and gets roped into her son's squad.
mira.challenge: The game has no puzzle-first way in. The Ratel is reached only through the Toybox Vessel Changer and a seat swap, the quest chain asks her to win four flying races first, and the Honeyguide has no arena card, so the day her son asks her in, there is no seat for her.

jonah.name: Jonah
jonah.is: Mira's son, 14. Arena most days after school with two friends; flies the Honeyguide when his mum rides along.
jonah.challenge: The competitive core. How fast he reaches the arena decides whether he stays long enough to bring anyone in.

night-crew.name: The Night Crew
night-crew.is: Four friends in their 20s on PC. The arena most nights, voyages binged on weekends, all on voice.
night-crew.challenge: Four people, three seats. A squad and a voyage party are three, so one friend sits out every match unless a crew vessel takes two of them; and a weekend binge of voyages runs out of authored sagas fast.

commuter.is: Two 5 to 7 minute sittings on the train on an older phone, a third at lunch; plays to the daily reset.
commuter.challenge: Below the Session tier's 10-minute floor. Anything longer than one round does not fit a sitting, and a voyage cannot be finished between two stations.

painter.name: The Painter
painter.is: Toybox only. Paints with trails, flies the Wanderway, shares what they make, never competes.
painter.challenge: Earns nothing. Crystals come only from placing in matches, so the Toybox pays no progress and the long game never starts.

returner.name: The Returner
returner.is: Played a lot of games once. Tries it in week 1, drifts off, and only comes back if the long game changes.
returner.challenge: Needs a reason to come back. Today nothing in the build changes on a schedule (era), so a lapse is final.

party-host.name: The Party Host
party-host.is: Gets three or four friends into a party most evenings on mid-range phones; picks whatever everyone can play.
party-host.challenge: Plays only when the friends do, and every friend gets the same winner-takes-200 payout, so two of three go home with nothing from most matches.
